# Wayne Stiles

> > Biblical geography and spiritual insights connecting Holy Land locations with Christian faith and daily life.

Wayne Stiles offers biblical teaching through the lens of geography, exploring sites like the Sea of Galilee, Jerusalem, and other Holy Land locations to illuminate Jesus' ministry and Old Testament narratives. His work combines Israel tours, archaeological insights, and practical spiritual application for Christian living.

## Key Topics

- Biblical Geography
- Sea of Galilee
- Jerusalem
- Jesus' Ministry
- Holy Land Travel
- Israel Tours
- Spiritual Perspective
- Biblical Archaeology
- Old Testament History
- Sermon on the Mount
- Apostle Paul
- Unanswered Prayer
- Servant Leadership
- Biblical Wisdom
- Pictorial Library of Bible Lands

## Holy Land Sites and Biblical Geography

- [5 Must-See Christian Sites by the Sea of Galilee](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/5-must-see-christian-sites-by-the-sea-of-galilee): Essential Christian pilgrimage sites around Sea of Galilee and Jesus
- [How God Uses Geography to Shape Our Lives](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/how-god-uses-geography-to-shape-our-lives): Biblical geography's role in shaping faith and spiritual lessons
- [The Gates of Jerusalem Today and Tomorrow](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/the-gates-of-jerusalem-today-and-tomorrow): Eight gates of Jerusalem's Old City and Ezekiel's prophecy
- [Mount Arbel - A Panorama of Jesus' Ministry](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/mount-arbel-a-panorama-of-jesus-ministry): Mount Arbel overlook of Sea of Galilee and Jesus' ministry locations
- [Petra—the Lost and Found City of Wonder](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/petra-the-lost-and-found-city-of-wonder): Ancient Nabatean city Petra in Jordan with biblical Edom connections
- [My Virtual Reality Tour Through Jerusalem's Second Temple](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/virtual-reality-jerusalem-second-temple): VR experience at Western Wall exploring Second Temple as Jesus saw it
- [Finding the Dead Sea Scrolls Isn't Enough](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/finding-the-dead-sea-scrolls-isnt-enough): Qumran's Dead Sea Scrolls discovery requires belief and obedience

## Faith and Spiritual Growth

- [How to Deal with It When God Says NO to Your Specifics](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/deal-god-says-no): Dealing with unanswered prayer and faith when God says no
- [The Question We Ought to Ask When Hurting](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/the-question-we-ought-to-ask-when-hurting): Biblical perspective on suffering through Job and trusting God's purpose
- [Do You Love Me? Four words at Tabgha are the motivation for your life.](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/do-you-love-me-motivation): Jesus' question to Peter at Tabgha reveals our spiritual motivation
- [Try Rubbernecking to God's Perspective for a Change](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/how-to-put-your-faith-in-front-of-your-feelings): Shifting perspective from bad days to God's view like King David
- [The Roman Forum and God's Surprising Ways in Your Life](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/roman-forum-gods-surprising-ways): Paul's Rome imprisonment mirrors God's unexpected redirections in life
- [Why We Should Default to Grace Rather than to Criticism](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/why-we-should-default-to-grace-rather-than-to-criticism): Choosing empathy and grace over criticism through everyday encounters

## Biblical Teaching and Wisdom

- [The Surprising Secret to Greatness We Need to Discover](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/the-surprising-secret-to-greatness-we-need-to-discover): Jesus teaches servant leadership and true greatness to the disciples
- [Offerings in Leviticus—What They Were and Why They Mattered](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/offerings-in-leviticus-what-they-were-and-why-they-mattered): Guide to Levitical offerings and Old Testament sacrifices for Christians
- [What Makes Your Nostalgia So Risky?](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/what-makes-your-nostalgia-so-risky): How nostalgia distorts memory and affects biblical decision-making

## Optional

- [4 Benefits of Getting Really Sick](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/4-benefits-of-getting-really-sick): Spiritual lessons from illness: weakness, humility, and heaven's hope
- [Joppa and the Long Highway](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/joppa-and-the-long-highway): Insight for Living Israel tour exploring Joppa's biblical geography
- [I'm Writing a New Book, and I'd Like Your Opinion](https://www.waynestiles.com/blog/surveys-im-writing-a-new-book-and-id-like-your-opinion): Baker Publishing book on Joseph and waiting on God - reader survey
